_notes: Read by scripts/modrinth-publish.mjs (keys starting with '_' are ignored). See modrinth/README.md.
Links (source_url, issues_url, wiki_url, discord_url, license_url): null = not set, otherwise an https:// URL.

extra_loaders: target name -> additional Modrinth loader tags for that target's jar. Final 1.1.0 release JARs were launched on NeoForge 47.1.106 (1.20.1-forge) and Quilt Loader 0.30.1 (1.20.1-fabric, 1.21.1-fabric, 1.21.11-fabric, 26.2-fabric). All load key mixins and render animations; 26.2 Quilt passes the full self-test. The other four production runs stop at development-only reflection diagnostics after the loading/rendering checks; see docs/validation-1.1.0.md for exact evidence and limitations. 26.3-fabric remains untagged: stable Quilt 0.30.1 provides fabricloader 0.19.3, below its required >=0.19.5; previous beta-loader success is not a current stable-loader claim. Other Fabric jars were not tested on Quilt.
dependencies_by_loader: added to every version whose target uses that loader ('name' is informational only).
title: Typing Animation
summary: Animated typing, smooth text and a customizable gliding cursor for Minecraft chat, signs and text fields. Client-side only.
